user.title: Watchmen motion detection
user.description: Pick the cameras Watchmen should watch. Motion is detected from camera events (ONVIF and friends) or by analyzing frames — automatic mode picks the best option per camera.

init.title: Watchmen options
init.description: Motion, LLM provider and face identification settings.

data.ai_task_entity: AI task entity for access reviews
data.identify_threshold: Minimum match percentage to identify a person

error.api_key_required: An API key is required for this provider.

request_access.name: Request access review
request_access.description: Ask the AI to review a camera snapshot and return an approve/deny decision. Fails closed on errors.

context.name: Context
context.description: Free-text description of why access was requested (e.g. which trigger fired).

add_face.name: Add face
add_face.description: Enroll a photo for a person. Provide a camera (snapshot is taken now) or a base64 image. Add several photos per person for better matching.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Take the photo from this camera now.

image.name: Image (base64)
image.description: Base64 encoded photo instead of a camera snapshot.

remove_face.name: Remove face
remove_face.description: Forget a person and all their enrolled photos.

name.name: Person name
name.description: Name of the person to remove.

list_faces.name: List faces
list_faces.description: List enrolled people with their photo counts.

identify_person.name: Identify person
identify_person.description: Analyze frames around the trigger, crop the visible face and match it against the enrolled gallery. Returns the person name and a confidence percentage. Fails closed.

frames_back.name: Frames back
frames_back.description: How many buffered frames before the trigger to check.

frames_forward.name: Frames forward
frames_forward.description: How many frames to capture after the trigger.

camera_not_configured.message: Camera {camera} is not configured in Watchmen.

ai_task_missing.message: No AI Task service is available. Configure an AI provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, ...) and an AI task entity in Watchmen options.

review_failed.message: The access review failed: {error}. Access was denied (fail closed).

no_faces_enrolled.message: No faces are enrolled. Use watchmen.add_face first.

no_frames_captured.message: No frames could be captured from {camera}.

invalid_image.message: The image could not be read: {error}.

add_face_source.message: Provide either a camera or a base64 image — not both, not neither.

api_key_missing.message: No API key configured for {provider}. Add it in the Watchmen options.

attachment_unsupported.message: Attachment {attachment} could not be read for the LLM request.
